question: When edit budget and low-order graph statistics are held fixed, does changing a mapped relationship damage compatibility with a role-equivalent target more selectively than changing residual path realization?

blindIntervention.centerAlignment: same label-blind D4 selection plus deterministic sparse kind-preserving nearest-center mapping used by local-wiring motif v7
blindIntervention.candidateOrder: lexicographically first valid pair after deterministic bucket ordering
blindIntervention.relationshipTwin: degree-preserving double-edge swap: (u,v),(x,y) -> (u,y),(x,v), with four distinct endpoints and absent cross-edges
blindIntervention.renderingTwin: keep adjacency fixed and swap only the two edge bundles' mean turn-rate and tortuosity profiles
preservedByConstruction: exact node degree sequence under the relationship twin
exact parallel multiplicity of the two edited bundles
coarse normalized path-length class of the edited bundles
endpoint kind plus degree-class edge stratum
global residual-geometry profile inventory under the rendering twin

primaryOutcome.representation: length-aware local wiring motif tokens from v7: endpoint/junction kind, capped degree, adjacency, parallel multiplicity class, and 0.05 normalized path-length bin
primaryOutcome.affectedRoots: mapped roots in the source graph within graph distance <=2 of any edited endpoint, excluding the four edited endpoints themselves
primaryOutcome.pairStatistic: mean over affected roots of [motif_distance(relationship_twin,target) - motif_distance(rendering_twin,target)]
primaryOutcome.interpretation: positive means the relationship edit damages surrounding target compatibility more than the residual-geometry edit

ablations: direct-root score including the four edited endpoints
raw residual geometry separation and new-chord shift as nuisance diagnostics

feasibility.note: Thresholds and the later minimum-two-root eligibility repair were set from label-blind feasibility only. The first blind screen showed that endpoint exclusion could leave an otherwise valid swap with no neighboring mapped root; no role label or scientific outcome was opened before adding this eligibility requirement.

null.shuffle: within exact occupant-family pair in Cleveland/train, shuffle preserved/broken labels over already-frozen intervention scores

adjudication.THREE_LANE_PROTECTED_RELATIONSHIP: feasible; train and holdout gates pass; control effect is same-direction and >=0.05
adjudication.TWO_LANE_PROTECTED_RELATIONSHIP: feasible; train and holdout gates pass; control does not reach the three-lane threshold
adjudication.GENERIC_GRAPH_DAMAGE_COMPATIBLE: feasible but train or holdout primary gate fails; relationship rewiring is not selectively more damaging in role-preserved pairs under the frozen test
adjudication.INFEASIBLE: any lane falls below its predeclared intervention count; measurement failure only

claimBoundary: A protected-relationship result would show that, within Mark's frozen anonymous correspondence world, low-order-matched relationship rewiring selectively disrupts compatibility with targets already labeled role-preserved more than an equally localized residual-geometry intervention. It would not prove historical semantics, cognition, chronology, or literal machine execution; synthetic graph counterfactuals are not pixel-realized marks.
